title: Appeal-Route Allowance on Expedited Exception Approvals, by Member Appeals Program Design (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, an appeal-route allowance is added to the exigency period of an expedited exception approval. It follows how the member's appeal program in the Member Appeals Program handles an urgent dispute.

| The member's appeal program | Allowance added |
|---|---|
| offers external review, and lets an expedited external review run alongside the internal appeal | the concurrent-route allowance of **2** days |
| offers external review, but only after the internal appeal | the program's urgent internal appeal hours divided by twenty-four |
| offers no external review | none |

The allowance is added to the exigency period before the floor of one day is applied.

*Hypothetical programs.*
- A program offering concurrent expedited external review adds 2 days.
- A program offering external review only after the internal appeal, with urgent appeals decided in 72 hours, adds 3 days.
- A program offering no external review adds nothing.
